text: Production supervisors say the daily work-order report takes almost a minute to load. We diagnose this the right way -- with evidence, not a guess.
First, capture the actual execution plan: a Clustered Index Scan is reading every row in WorkOrders. Then read SQL Server's own missing-index recommendation. Only then do we measure before and after.
The missing-index DMVs point at Status, ScheduledStartDate, and MachineID, with an estimated ninety-three percent impact -- that's SQL Server's own optimizer talking, not a hunch.
We build that index online, by name, so the production floor's own writes keep running. Fifty-two seconds before. About four-tenths of a second after -- an index seek instead of a scan.
The report is fast and the fix is proven. Next, we make sure these backups survive more than just a server failure.
